notes.text:
Same code, two recipes.

Edit app.js: greet-dev (3001) changes straight away. greet (3000) only changes when you build it again, with a new tag.

docker build -t greet:3.0 .                       # uses Dockerfile (the default name)
docker build -f Dockerfile.dev -t greet:dev .     # -f = which recipe, . = which folder
docker build -f greet/Dockerfile.dev -t greet:dev greet   # same, from the folder above
